title: state.json and lanes become rebuildable projections
action: Projection layer: .bee/state.json and .bee/lanes/<feature>.json are rebuilt read-only from workflow records (newest active workflow = default projection; per-feature workflow = lane projection). bee-state-sync hook writes projections only, never source of truth. A rebuild verb/function regenerates both from records; test: delete projections, rebuild, byte-stable; deleting a projection loses nothing (invariants 13/14). Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/ (vendored to .bee/bin/ + plugin mirrors). Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed).

truths: existing readers (status, prompt-context) see unchanged shapes
prohibitions: no consumer writes through a projection

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check
